item.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Docs and Slides and Merges Chat Interfaces
item.description:
Anthropic Introduces Claude Docs and Slides and Merges Chat Interfaces

Anthropic is updating Claude by introducing two new beta productivity tools, Docs and Slides, and merging its chat interfaces into a single experience.

🧩 How it works

Claude can now generate documents and presentations directly from any chat. Users can request changes to these creations or make edits manually.

  • Claude Docs: These begin as private documents that can be shared with other editors for simultaneous collaboration. Collaborators and Claude can leave comments similar to those found in Google Docs.
  • Claude Slides: These allow users to create presentations through Claude chats.
  • Unified Access: Everything created with Claude Design, Slides, or Docs is hosted at one shareable link accessible via mobile phones.

⚙️ Key details

Anthropic is simplifying the user experience by merging regular chats and Cowork into “one Claude.”

Feature Description
One Claude A single interface merging regular chats and Cowork, making all AI productivity tools available from any chat.
Integration Artifacts and Claude Design capabilities are available through the new single interface.
Task Handling Claude can determine what a task needs to provide Cowork and Design capabilities from any conversation using existing context, skills, and connectors.

🚀 Availability

The “one Claude” update and new tools are rolling out over the next few weeks with the following terms:

  • Initial Access: Pro and Max users on web, desktop, and mobile.
  • Future Access: Team and Free users.
  • Activation: There is “nothing to turn on” for the update, and users may continue using Claude chat normally.

#Anthropic #Claude #AIProductivity #AItools

Source: Claude comes for Gemini with its own take on Docs and Slides Source: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude

item.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Docs and Slides in Beta
item.description:
Anthropic Launches Claude Docs and Slides in Beta

Anthropic is introducing two new productivity tools, Claude Docs and Claude Slides, which allow users to create, edit, and share documents and presentations directly from Claude chats.

🧩 How it works

Users can generate documents and presentations from any chat and make changes by asking Claude to modify them or by editing manually.

  • Collaboration: Docs start as private but can be shared with other editors for real-time collaboration.
  • Commenting: Collaborators and Claude can leave comments on documents.
  • Accessibility: Content created with Docs, Slides, or Claude Design is hosted at one shareable link accessible via phone.

⚙️ Key details

Anthropic is implementing an update called “one Claude,” which merges regular chats and Cowork into a single interface. This allows the AI to determine what a task needs, making the skills and connectors of Cowork and Design available from any conversation.

Tool Functionality
Claude Docs Create, edit, and share documents via chat
Claude Slides Create, edit, and share presentations via chat
Claude Design AI productivity capabilities available in the single interface
Artifacts Productivity capabilities available in the single interface

🚀 Availability

The “one Claude” update is rolling out over the next few weeks to Pro and Max users on web, desktop, and mobile. Access for Free and Team users will follow later. Anthropic states there is “nothing to turn on” for the update, and users may continue using Claude chat normally.

💡 Why it matters

These tools allow Anthropic to compete with Google, which has natively tied Gemini into its suite of productivity tools, including features for generating and editing documents and creating slides. The addition of Docs and Slides is intended to close the gap between Anthropic’s platform and Google’s tools, reducing the need for users to leave Claude chats for other applications.

#Anthropic #Claude #AIproductivity #AItools

Source: Claude comes for Gemini with its own take on Docs and Slides

item.title: Holo1-3B: The Open-Source VLM Redefining Web Automation Cost-Efficiency
item.description:
🚀 Holo1-3B: The Open-Source VLM Redefining Web Automation Cost-Efficiency

𝙎𝙪𝙢𝙢𝙖𝙧𝙮: HCompany’s new Holo1-3B model delivers state-of-the-art web automation capabilities at a fraction of the cost of GPT-4 alternatives. This Action Vision-Language Model powers the Surfer-H web agent system with impressive accuracy on UI localization tasks while offering the best accuracy-to-cost ratio in the industry.

🔍 Introduction: Web Agents That See and Act Like Humans

In today’s rapidly evolving AI landscape, the ability for models to interact with web interfaces like humans do represents a significant frontier. Web automation traditionally required complex programming, brittle selectors, or expensive API solutions. But what if an AI could simply look at a website and identify where to click, just as a human would?

That’s exactly what HCompany has achieved with their new Holo1-3B model, an open-source Vision-Language Model (VLM) specifically built for web automation. Designed as part of the Surfer-H web agent system, it demonstrates remarkable capabilities that position it as a compelling alternative to expensive proprietary solutions.

Let’s explore why this matters and how this technology could transform how we automate web interactions.

🧠 Understanding Holo1 and Surfer-H Architecture

Holo1 isn’t just another VLM—it’s an Action Vision-Language Model specifically optimized for web interaction. As part of the Surfer-H agent architecture, it acts in one of three critical roles:

  • 𝗣𝗼𝗹𝗶𝗰𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹: Makes decisions and plans the agent’s behavior
  • 𝗟𝗼𝗰𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗿 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹: Visually understands UI elements to enable precise interactions
  • 𝗩𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗼𝗿 𝗺𝗼𝗱𝗲𝗹: Verifies whether actions produced the desired results

What sets Surfer-H apart is its human-like approach to web navigation—it thinks before acting, takes notes, and can retry if its answer is rejected. Rather than relying on custom APIs or brittle DOM selectors, it operates purely through the browser interface, just as a human would.

The system’s modular design allows for flexible configuration with different models for each component, enabling strategic tradeoffs between accuracy, speed, and cost.

💰 Pareto-Optimal Performance: Better Results at Lower Costs

When evaluated on the WebVoyager benchmark—a collection of 643 real-world web tasks ranging from price checking to event scheduling—Holo1-powered agents delivered remarkable results:

  • 🔥 Surfer-H + Holo1-7B: 92.2% accuracy at $0.13 per task
  • 🔥 Surfer-H + Holo1-3B: 89.7% accuracy at $0.11 per task

For comparison, proprietary alternatives achieved:

  • GPT-4.1: 92.0% accuracy at $0.54 per task
  • GPT-4.1-mini: 88.8% accuracy at $0.26 per task

This positions Holo1 on the Pareto frontier—delivering the best accuracy per dollar spent. At approximately 1/5th the cost of GPT-4.1 for similar performance, the economic implications for organizations deploying web automation at scale are substantial.

🎯 Excelling at UI Localization

A critical skill for web agents is UI localization—identifying precisely where to click or interact with a user interface. Holo1 demonstrates state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks:

  • Screenspot
  • Screenspot-V2
  • Screenspot-Pro
  • GroundUI-Web
  • WebClick (HCompany’s new benchmark)

This localization capability is what enables Holo1 to interact with websites like a human would—by visually identifying UI elements rather than relying on hidden code structures that might change frequently.

🛠️ Getting Started with Holo1-3B

The best part? Holo1-3B is available now and relatively simple to implement. Based on the Qwen2.5-VL architecture, it’s accessible through Hugging Face’s transformers library.

Here’s a simplified implementation workflow:

  1. Load the model and processor:
1
2
3
4
5
6

model = AutoModelForImageTextToText.from_pretrained(
 "Hcompany/Holo1-3B",
 torch_dtype="auto",
 device_map="auto",
)
processor = AutoProcessor.from_pretrained("Hcompany/Holo1-3B")

  1. Process images with care: Since Holo1 uses absolute pixel coordinates, make sure to use the provided smart_resize function to ensure coordinate accuracy.

  2. Choose your interaction style:

    • Simple click coordinates: x, y
    • Structured JSON output for more complex interactions
    • Full navigation steps with rich context awareness

For example, having the model select a checkout date on a calendar:

1
2
3

instruction = "Select July 14th as the check-out date"
prompt = localization.get_localization_prompt(image, instruction)
coordinates = run_inference(prompt)[0]

The model can also handle more complex tasks:

1
2
3

task = "Book a hotel in Paris on August 3rd for 3 nights"
prompt = navigation.get_navigation_prompt(task, image, step=1)
navigation_str = run_inference(prompt)[0]

🔮 The Future of Web Automation

Holo1-3B represents a significant step toward accessible, cost-effective web automation that works like a human user would. Its open-source nature and impressive performance metrics position it as a viable alternative to much more expensive proprietary solutions.

The implications extend beyond simple cost savings. By making sophisticated web automation more accessible, Holo1 could democratize automation capabilities that were previously available only to organizations with significant AI budgets.

As models like Holo1 continue to evolve, we might see entirely new categories of applications emerge—from personalized web assistants to enterprise-scale automation solutions that operate through visual interfaces rather than APIs or code.

🤔 Final Thoughts

When we consider the trajectory of AI development, models like Holo1-3B reveal an important shift: from general-purpose models to specialized systems that excel at specific, high-value tasks. This specialization enables better performance at lower costs, making capabilities more accessible to a wider range of users and organizations.

As we move forward, will we see more domain-specialized models outperform general-purpose alternatives? And how might this change the economics of AI deployment across industries?

item.title: 🔍 Bot Scanner: Building the 'Skyscanner' for LLM Answers in the Agentic AI Era
item.description:
🔍 Bot Scanner: Building the “Skyscanner” for LLM Answers in the Agentic AI Era

📊 Summary

Bot Scanner emerges as a revolutionary platform that queries multiple LLMs simultaneously and uses AI judges to rank their responses—effectively creating a “Skyscanner for AI answers” that saves time and improves decision-making in our increasingly complex AI ecosystem. This 5-minute read explores how this tool transforms LLM response evaluation and why it matters for the emerging agentic AI landscape.

🚀 The Paradox of AI Choice Paralysis

In today’s rapidly evolving AI landscape, we face a peculiar dilemma: more choice, more confusion. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, DeepSeek—the list grows daily. Each model excels at different tasks, leaving us with the nagging question: “𝘐𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘣𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦 𝘢𝘯𝘴𝘸𝘦𝘳 𝘧𝘰𝘳 𝘮𝘺 𝘴𝘱𝘦𝘤𝘪𝘧𝘪𝘤 𝘶𝘴𝘦 𝘤𝘢𝘴𝘦?”

Many applications now offer side-by-side LLM comparisons, but they still require 𝙮𝙤𝙪 to manually evaluate each response—a tedious process reminiscent of booking flights by visiting individual airline websites. 🛫

Enter Bot Scanner: a platform that not only queries multiple language models with a single prompt but crucially employs other AI models to evaluate and rank those responses. It’s the meta-AI solution we’ve been waiting for, offering a simple chatbot-like interface that hides sophisticated evaluation machinery.

🧠 How Bot Scanner Works: AI Evaluating AI

Bot Scanner operates through an elegant two-step process:

  1. Broadcast Phase 📢 — Your prompt is sent to multiple “responder” LLMs that you select
  2. Evaluation Phase ⚖️ — Responses are passed to your chosen “ranker” LLMs that judge quality and produce a ranked list

This architecture provides unprecedented control over the evaluation chain—from selecting the contestants to appointing the jury. Think of it as creating a custom AI talent show where you choose both the performers and the judges! 🏆

1

User Prompt → [Responder LLMs] → Multiple Answers → [Ranker LLMs] → Ranked Results

The 𝗽𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗯𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗳𝗶𝘁𝘀 are immediately apparent:

  • ⏱️ Time Efficiency: No more manual sifting through multiple outputs
  • 🎯 Better Decisions: Quickly identify high-quality responses based on criteria evaluated by trusted AI judges
  • 🛠️ Agent Optimization: For developers building AI agents, Bot Scanner helps select the optimal “expert” LLMs for each component task

🔄 The Evolution: From AutoBench to Bot Scanner

Bot Scanner didn’t emerge from a vacuum. Its genesis lies in AutoBench, an advanced benchmarking framework developed by eZecute that pioneered the “Collective-LLM-as-a-Judge” paradigm.

🧩 The traditional benchmarking approach has significant limitations:

  • Static datasets quickly become outdated
  • Models can be fine-tuned to game specific benchmarks
  • Human evaluation doesn’t scale efficiently

AutoBench addressed these issues by using a collective of AI models to evaluate other AIs—a method specifically designed to be “ASI-ready” (Artificial Superintelligence ready), capable of assessing LLMs even when they surpass human evaluation capabilities.

The team behind AutoBench, including collaboration with AI researchers like Marco Trombetti and support from companies like Transalted, realized that this sophisticated evaluation system could be packaged into an accessible tool for everyday use.

𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙧𝙚𝙨𝙪𝙡𝙩? Bot Scanner. 🎉

🤖 The Agentic Era: Why Evaluation Matters More Than Ever

We’re rapidly approaching what experts call the “agentic era” of AI—where systems autonomously execute complex, multi-step tasks with minimal human guidance. This evolution brings a unique challenge: how do we ensure these agents consistently deliver effective results aligned with our intentions?

This shift requires us to rethink the traditional “Mixture of Experts” (MoE) paradigm. Rather than internal neural sub-networks, we’re seeing systems where distinct, specialized LLMs collaborate like a team of experts. Imagine a market research agent where:

  • One LLM excels at data retrieval 📊
  • Another specializes in sentiment analysis 🧐
  • A third focuses on creative brainstorming 💡

While powerful, this “multi-LLM agent” approach makes evaluation exponentially more complex. How do you select the right AI “expert” for each sub-task?

Bot Scanner offers a solution by providing real-time, task-specific evaluation that can guide these choices. It’s not just about comparing models—it’s about building better AI systems through informed selection.

💎 Bot Scanner: A Specialized Tool for Critical Decisions

It’s important to understand what Bot Scanner is—and isn’t.

Bot Scanner isn’t a replacement for everyday chatbots like ChatGPT or Gemini. Instead, it’s a specialized tool for situations where accuracy and quality across multiple models are paramount. This depth comes at a computational cost; a single query might involve hundreds of LLM calls, making it up to 100 times more expensive than standard LLM queries.

Similarly, Bot Scanner isn’t a general benchmarking system. Rather than providing broad performance metrics across thousands of interactions, it delivers immediate, question-specific rankings focused on your exact use case.

🔮 The Future is Continuously Evaluated

As AI systems become more powerful and autonomous, the need for robust, dynamic evaluation will only grow. Static benchmarks will continue to serve their purpose, but tools like Bot Scanner represent the necessary evolution toward context-aware, user-driven evaluation.

The ultimate goal? To give everyone—from individual researchers to large teams—accessible means to navigate the increasingly complex AI landscape and make better-informed decisions about the AI they deploy.

The question isn’t whether we’ll need tools like Bot Scanner—it’s how quickly we can integrate this meta-evaluative approach into our AI development and usage workflows. As models continue multiplying and specializing, will you still manually compare outputs, or leverage AI itself to identify the best responses for your specific needs? 🤔
